bounds_and_proof_limits.native_attempts: At most8 selected function operations, each collector-bounded1-5 attempts (at most40 function SDK attempts, excluding existing STS/auth/other independently selected metadata APIs); SDK automatic retries disabled; scan cancellation/deadline checked before attempts and around projection/scans.
bounds_and_proof_limits.post_receipt_memory: Boto3 already allocated the full parsed response before _size. Bounded scalar/tree preflight and incremental serialization count prevent an additional whole-response retained encoding, but do not limit bytes allocated/transferred by the SDK before receipt. No streaming/preallocation guarantee claimed.
bounds_and_proof_limits.wall_clock: 60s controls inspection/admission/scanner work; profile has3s/5s connect/read inactivity caps. SDK credential resolution or continuously arriving response can exceed that elapsed time; post-return checks prevent late clean PASS. This is not a new hard wall-clock cancellation primitive for SDK transport.
bounds_and_proof_limits.cleanup: No content files/download/archive/extraction/process execution. Only ephemeral native in-memory response/payload is scanned; shared scanner subprocess cleanup/output caps inherited unchanged. Python memory not guaranteed cryptographic erasure.
bounds_and_proof_limits.scope: Native integration exercised commercial AWS/us-east-1; parser supports conservative aws/aws-cn/aws-us-gov ARN/Region pairing. ISO/other partitions, uncommon names outside bounded subset, account-only scopes, aliases/published versions/runtime-injected variables and history unsupported.
bounds_and_proof_limits.literal_only: Client-side ciphertext or additional encodings are not decrypted/decoded. PASS is about supported literal bytes and detector rules, not hidden plaintext or every secret format. Secret-store reference strings are never fetched as payloads.
bounds_and_proof_limits.coverage: No claims for function Description, code/packages/layers, logs, container images, unselected functions, current invocation environment, effective access or credential validity.
